name: AuditRound10.linear_interfaces
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (u v : Vec n) (a : ℝ),
(J n (u + v) = J n u + J n v) ∧ (J n (a • v) = a • J n v) ∧
    (P_preserve n (u + v) = P_preserve n u + P_preserve n v) ∧
    (P_preserve n (a • v) = a • P_preserve n v) ∧
    (P_break n (u + v) = P_break n u + P_break n v) ∧
    (P_break n (a • v) = a • P_break n v)

name: AuditRound10.reversal_coordinate
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Vec n) (i : Fin (2 * n)),
J n v i = v ⟨2 * n - 1 - i.val, by omega⟩

name: AuditRound10.reversal_involution
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Vec n),
J n (J n v) = v

name: AuditRound10.projection_coordinates
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Vec n) (i : Fin (2 * n)),
P_preserve n v i = (v i - v i.rev) / 2 ∧
    P_break n v i = (v i + v i.rev) / 2

name: AuditRound10.preserve_eigen
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Vec n),
J n (P_preserve n v) = -P_preserve n v

name: AuditRound10.break_eigen
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Vec n),
J n (P_break n v) = P_break n v

name: AuditRound10.projection_decomposition
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Vec n),
P_preserve n v + P_break n v = v

name: AuditRound10.projection_idempotence
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Vec n),
P_preserve n (P_preserve n v) = P_preserve n v ∧
    P_break n (P_break n v) = P_break n v

name: AuditRound10.projection_annihilation
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Vec n),
P_preserve n (P_break n v) = 0 ∧
    P_break n (P_preserve n v) = 0

name: AuditRound10.projection_fixed_iff
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Vec n),
(P_preserve n v = v ↔ J n v = -v) ∧
    (P_break n v = v ↔ J n v = v)

name: AuditRound10.reversal_dot
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (u v : Vec n),
dotProduct (J n u) (J n v) = dotProduct u v

name: AuditRound10.projection_orthogonal
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (u v : Vec n),
dotProduct (P_preserve n u) (P_break n v) = 0

name: AuditRound10.reflection_involution
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (x : Vec n),
reflect (reflect x) = x

name: AuditRound10.reflection_perturbation
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (x v : Vec n) (t : ℝ),
reflect (x + t • v) = reflect x - t • J n v

name: AuditRound10.reflection_at_fixed
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (x u v : Vec n) (t : ℝ)
    (hx : reflect x = x),
reflect (x + t • (P_preserve n u + P_break n v)) =
      x + t • (P_preserve n u - P_break n v)

name: AuditRound10.preserved_perturbation_iff
type_in_namespace:
∀ {n : ℕ} (x v : Vec n)
    (hx : reflect x = x),
reflect (x + v) = x + v ↔ J n v = -v

name: AuditRound10.phase_root_unique
AuditRound10.bracket_unique_root
type_in_namespace:
∀ {Phi : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hc : ContinuousOn Phi (Set.Ici 0))
    (hm : StrictMonoOn Phi (Set.Ici 0))
    (k : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hl : Phi a ≤ (k : ℝ) * Real.pi) (hr : (k : ℝ) * Real.pi ≤ Phi b),
∃! x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Icc a b ∧ phase_root Phi k x

name: AuditRound10.phase_index_order
AuditRound10.indexed_roots_strict_mono
type_in_namespace:
∀ {Phi : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hm : StrictMonoOn Phi (Set.Ici 0)) (index : ℕ → ℕ) (roots : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hi : StrictMono index) (hr : ∀ m, phase_root Phi (index m) (roots m)),
StrictMono roots

name: AuditRound10.enumeration_from_brackets
type_in_namespace:
∀ {Phi : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hc : ContinuousOn Phi (Set.Ici 0))
    (hm : StrictMonoOn Phi (Set.Ici 0))
    (index : ℕ → ℕ) (hi : StrictMono index) (left right : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hleft : ∀ m, 0 ≤ left m) (horder : ∀ m, left m ≤ right m)
    (hl : ∀ m, Phi (left m) ≤ (index m : ℝ) * Real.pi)
    (hr : ∀ m, (index m : ℝ) * Real.pi ≤ Phi (right m)),
∃ roots : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ m, roots m ∈ Set.Icc (left m) (right m) ∧ phase_root Phi (index m) (roots m)) ∧
      StrictMono roots
